title: 第91章 原来，李三奎不是亲生的

第91章 原来，李三奎不是亲生的-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

村民中有心肠好的，自然也就有心肠坏的，有心术正的，更有见不得人好，有人会帮忙平事，也有人喜欢拱火，更何况李青山在石溪村内，可有好几个死对头。

果然，李大奎话音落下，赵贵就立刻道：“说的不错，李青山这小子以前就是个二流子，哪里会打猎，肯定是因为祖宗的萌阴这才运气这么好，上山就能打到猎物的，给老李家一多半的猎物，没什么问题。”

“李青山，做人可不能没有良心，就凭你小子也能打到野物，不过是靠着祖宗的风水好，我觉得李大奎说得对。”

“就是，这鱼啊，得给老李家分！”

赵铁蛋和麻子婶，赵瞎子等人，全都齐刷刷开口，这是见不得李青山好的。

“大哥，这是我家儿子凭本事抓的，凭什么要分给你们？”李三奎鼓足了勇气，开口反驳道。

作为老三的李三奎，因为没有父母撑腰，从小到大都未曾反驳过大哥，但是今日竟然敢站出来反驳，这倒是让李青山很欣慰，自己老爹总算是成长了，日后就算是自己不在家中，也不是谁想欺负就会被欺负的了。

“娘的，老三，你个瘪犊子玩意长本事了是不是，敢这么和你大哥我说话？”

“乡亲们，这些鱼有三分之二是我们老李家的，大家一起帮忙把鱼拿到我老李家去，但凡是愿意上去帮忙的，到我老李家后，我给你们分鱼，每个人都至少一条鱼。”

李大奎振臂一呼，脸上满是跋扈之色，小小李三奎，老子还拿捏不了你了？

果然。

李大奎话音落下，村里人立刻开始躁动了起来，纷纷撸了撸袖子，准备上去动手了，当然也有一些人并不打算上手，比如说豆腐西施，满仓，保山这些人退了退。

这些村民要是一起冲上来，也是难办。

不过，李青山心中早已想好了应对之法，别人抢就抢，自己就照着李大奎揍。

“什么狗屁祖坟？”

然而。

就在不少人准备动手的时候，一道老人的声音突然从人群后传了过来。

老拐爷！

一众村民连忙让开一条路，让一名拎着拐棍的老人迈着老态龙钟的步子，气势颇足的走过来。

“老拐爷，您老慢些！”

Among the villagers, there are some who are good-hearted, and naturally there are also some who are bad-hearted, some who have good intentions, and some who are shady. Some people will help to make peace, while others like to make peace. What's more, Li Qingshan has several sworn enemies in Shixi Village.

Sure enough, after Li Dakui finished speaking, Zhao Gui immediately said: "That's right. Li Qingshan used to be a second-rate kid. He knows how to hunt. It must be because of his ancestor's Meng Yin that he is so lucky. He can catch prey by going up the mountain. There is no problem in giving more than half of the prey to the old Li family."

"Li Qingshan, you can't be a man without conscience. You can hunt wild animals just by relying on your ancestors' good feng shui. I think Li Dakui is right."

"That's right, this fish must be divided among Lao Li's family!"

Zhao Tiedan, Aunt Mazi, Zhao Xiazi and others all opened their mouths at the same time, not wanting to see Li Qingshan's kindness.

"Brother, my son caught this on his own merit, why should I share it with you?" Li Sankui mustered up his courage and retorted.

As the third child, Li Sankui has never refuted his elder brother since he was a child because he has no support from his parents. However, he dared to stand up and refute today. This makes Li Qingshan very happy. His father has finally grown up. In the future, even if he is not at home, he will not be bullied by anyone who wants to bully him.

"Damn, third child, you little brat has grown up, haven't you? How dare you talk to me, your elder brother, like this?"

"Folks, two-thirds of these fish belong to our Lao Li family. Let's help bring the fish to my Lao Li's house. Anyone who is willing to help me will share the fish with you after you arrive at my Lao Li's house. Everyone will have at least one fish."

Li Dakui raised his arms and shouted, his face full of domineering expression, "Little Li Sankui, I can't control you anymore?"

really.

After Li Dakui finished speaking, the villagers immediately became restless, rolling up their sleeves and preparing to take action. Of course, there were some people who did not intend to take action, such as Tofu Xishi, Mancang, and Baoshan, who retreated.

It would be difficult if all these villagers rushed up together.

However, Li Qingshan had already thought of a way to deal with it. If others robbed him, he would beat him like Li Dakui.

"What bullshit ancestral grave?"

However.

Just when many people were about to take action, an old man's voice suddenly came from behind the crowd.

Old man!

A group of villagers quickly moved out of the way, allowing an old man carrying a walking stick to walk over with a senile pace.

"Old man, please be slower!"
